Why HackerEarth
Why tech recruiters choose HackerEarth's online recruiting software
HackerEarth helps recruiters identify top tech talent with automated skill assessments, real-time coding challenges, and data-backed hiring decisions.
Create
Easy, accurate evaluation of candidates for multiple roles across all levels
Whether you need to hire by role, or for a particular skill, HackerEarth can help by letting you easily create coding tests for over 100+ roles and 1000+ skills, for hundreds of candidates.
Evaluate
Standardise feedback and collaborate easily with hiring managers
HackerEarth makes it easy for tech recruiters and hiring managers to collectively evaluate a candidate and make collaborative decisions with our online recruitment software.
Streamline hiring with seamless ATS integrations
Thanks to a seamless integration with the ATS provider of your choice, our candidate screening tool lets you set up assessments for candidates and collect feedback from the hiring team, all in one go.
Eliminate bias in the hiring process by masking PII
HackerEarth helps tech recruiters create diverse teams and a culture of inclusion by keeping all assessments free of personally identifiable information, if needed.
Track, measure, and analyze your hiring success rate
Our online recruiting software for tech recruiters produces an insight-rich analysis of your hiring funnel, letting you continuously increase the effectiveness of your hiring process.
